  <!ELEMENT root (item)*>

]>

</root>

  <xi:include href="nonexistent.xml" parse="xml">

      <fallback-element>Default content</fallback-element>
    </xi:fallback>
  </xi:include>
</root>

</root>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ENTITY % int "<!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA | child)*>">
  %int;
  <!ELEMENT child EMPTY>
  <!ATTLIST child id ID #REQUIRED>
]>
<doc>
  <child id="id001"/>
</doc>
```

</doc>
